'''Laurain''' is a noblewoman from King [[Ailron]]'s court in [[Amadicia]]. She is slender and young with dark eyes set slightly too close together, and wears a permanent simper. 

==Activities==
Laurain was set to serve [[Morgase]] as one of her ladies-in-waiting during her stay in [[Amador]].
